## Voting

Reply to this issue with one:

| Vote | Meaning |
|------|---------|
| ✅ `APPROVE` | Approve as written |
| ❌ `REJECT` | Oppose (state reason) |
| 🔄 `MODIFY` | Request modification |
| ⏸️ `HOLD` | Hold for meeting (blocks async) |
| ➖ `ABSTAIN` | Abstain (counts for quorum) |
